title: YieldPoint
description: One date's yield reading for a single plant. Returned as an element of `plant_history(plant_id, from, to)`.

date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date in the plant's local timezone. Day-boundary aligned to `Plant.location.timezone` if present, else server-local.

yield_kwh.description: Total AC yield for that calendar day, in kilowatt-hours.

peak_kw.description: Optional. Peak instantaneous AC power observed during the day. Useful for performance-ratio calculation.

equivalent_hours.description: Optional. yield_kwh / capacity_kwp. Vendors that compute this server-side can supply it; otherwise consumers compute from `plant_list`.

data_quality.description: Optional. `final` = settled (typically >24h old). `provisional` = current-day or recently-settled, may revise. `estimated` = filled from neighbors due to comms gap. `missing` = vendor confirms no data for this date (distinct from zero yield).
